gen-righteous-gf-numans: Righteous fills every line with big round bowls, like thin steel rod bent into shape. Numans follows with widely spaced, swollen lowercase and an s whose ends hang away from the spine, a loose counterweight to the heading.
gen-righteous-gf-onest: Thin steel rod, bent into bowls that fill the line: that is Righteous. Onest sits underneath with short ascenders and big round shapes, and its soft, uniform line makes the loud heading feel friendly rather than shouty.
gen-righteous-gf-open-sans: Righteous bends bowls out of what looks like thin steel rod. Open Sans gives it a smooth, bulky-lowercase body with no clogged curves, so the commanding heading always has something easygoing to hand off to.
gen-righteous-gf-orienta: Round, loud and a bit cheeky. Righteous draws its lines with no hairline-to-stem shift, while Orienta answers with breathing counters and little height difference between cases, a quieter modern sans underneath.
gen-righteous-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens its letters wide like a pried oyster shell and stands on a lofty x-height. Righteous above it glides like wire.
gen-righteous-gf-roboto: Round and bold, built like bent steel rod. Righteous is best at commanding attention with its fat bowls, while Roboto does its best work quietly, with generous mouths on the round letters.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sofia-sans: Commanding is Metamorphous, with large sidebearings, a high midline and a soft shift between fat and slim strokes. Sofia Sans meets it with tall lowercase and no stroke modulation at all, a thread of ink.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk reads open and approachable, with big e and a shapes on tall bowls and terminals that never close in. Gugi, the heading, is bolder, with no thick-and-thin modulation and tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads clearly, its lowercase e wide open and its ascenders sitting close above the x-height. And Love Ya Like A Sister keeps a similar level beat, though its glass-tube lettering feels hollow and hand-made.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-radio-canada: Goldman is wide, bold and generously spaced. Radio Canada follows with tall, full lowercase, a pressure-free line and clear openings at every curve end, so extended reading goes down smoothly.
